question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Earnestly
solution:
The correct answer is **"****Sincerely."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Earnestly"** means with sincere and intense conviction; seriously. (दृढ़निश्‍चय के साथ)

 
 
• **Example**: *He stood with his hands on his hips, his head tilted slightly as he listened **earnestly**__ to questions.*
 
 
 
• The synonym of **"Earnestly"** is **"Sincerely."**
 
• The word **"Sincerely"** means in a sincere or genuine way. (निष्‍ठापूर्वक, सच्‍चाई से)
 __
 
• **Example**: *I am **sincerely**__ grateful to you for all your help.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, the​ correct answer is** Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Wordily: **in a way that contains a lot of words, or too many words. (एक तरह से जिसमें बहुत सारे शब्द हों, या बहुत सारे शब्द हों)
 
• **Ambiguously: **so as to be open to more than one interpretation. (अनेक अर्थ प्रकट करते हुए)
 
• **Verbosely: **in a way that uses too many words. (एक तरह से जो बहुत सारे शब्दों का उपयोग करता है)
